market_correction.title: Kill-question metric questioned by research (November 2026)
market_correction.text: The kill question passes if five farm shops report less shrinkage than the honesty box. A 2026 study found in the research reports the opposite correlation for self-checkout in general: more shrinkage, not less. The category itself is real and growing (Dorfladenbox, Ackerpay, Locafox case studies), so the idea stands, but the pass mark may be measuring the wrong thing. Before running the pilot, decide with the shops what success means: uptime, basket size, customer satisfaction, staff hours saved. Kill question unchanged pending Hans's decision. As researched November 2026 by web search; verify before relying on it.

market_correction.title: Compliance claim unverified; channel question (November 2026)
market_correction.text: The pack treats continuous hot-water temperature logging as a compliance requirement. The research could not confirm that logging itself, rather than periodic Legionella laboratory testing, is legally required; check the TrinkwV §31 text before repeating the claim to a buyer. Techem and Minol already hold the property-manager relationship through their testing services, so the better route may be selling through them rather than direct. Kill question unchanged pending Hans's decision; the three property managers in it are still worth asking, and ask them who they buy testing from. As researched November 2026 by web search; verify before relying on it.
